verdict.rationale: Thoropass explicitly supports multi-framework compliance (SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, HITRUST) from one unified platform, with dedicated framework pages, cross-framework control mapping, and unified action items/dashboards spanning frameworks. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration (e.g., customer case studies or reviews) confirming real-world multi-framework usage beyond vendor docs, and more detail on how PCI-specific requirements (ASV scans, pentesting) integrate operationally alongside HIPAA/GDPR in the same workspace.
